arguments.text: The contractual duty is explicitly limited to non-reproduction rather than a general duty to maintain confidentiality, creating a scope mismatch with the target statement.

arguments.text: The exception clause ("except as required to accomplish the intent of this Agreement") carves out permitted reproductions, which contradicts the strict or absolute confidentiality entailment proposed in φ.
